name: one-correction
title: One correction moves other grades
idea: Grades are chosen together, so correcting one unit's input, or dropping a unit, can change the relation between two other units.
from: new concept · theory book ch. 17 (information sets) and ch. 21 (transparency, appeal, documentation); postrank_compare() relations; picture: the card before and after the reader corrects one unit's mean or SD, or drops a unit, with the relation-change matrix and the count of changed pairs between units the reader did not touch
credit: After the postrank theory book, ch. 17 and 21.
caption: Independent normal teaching posteriors. Six-site reports are optimized in their named full or capped family; the frozen league uses best cuts of a recomputed expected-rank order. Removed units are excluded, not graded last.
